title: Finite generation descends along faithfully flat ring maps
statement: Let $\psi:R\to T$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] and $M$ an $R$-module. Regard $T\otimes_RM$ as a $T$-module by $t\cdot(u\otimes m)=tu\otimes m$. If $T\otimes_RM$ is a finitely generated $T$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], then $M$ is a finitely generated $R$-module.
